_schema.about: Declarative position-based task rules for the T-maze rig. Edit this file to add/tune rules without touching Python. Loaded by host/rules_view.py; evaluated by host/rules_engine.py. See docs/decisions/0023. Distances are in CENTIMETERS and converted to pixels via the spatial calibration in host/rig_scale.json (set it in the Rules tab's 'Measure scale' UI).

top_level.enabled: master default (the GUI still forces the engine OFF at startup for safety)
top_level.defaults: fallbacks applied to any rule that omits the field

defaults.min_confidence: 0..1; only act while the track is TRACKING with confidence >= this
defaults.topup_cooldown_ms: minimum ms between fires WITHIN a visit (prime->top-up, top-up->top-up); keep short
defaults.rearm_refractory_ms: anti-camp timer: minimum ms since the last fire before the rule may PRIME again on a fresh visit
defaults.global_min_interval_ms: runaway backstop: minimum ms between ANY two fires across all rules

rule_fields.template: which rule template to instantiate; currently: 'prime_and_lick_topup'
rule_fields.enabled: true/false; disable a rule without deleting it
rule_fields.landmark: {kind, index} of the annotated point (well 0=left,1=right,2=center; sensor 0..5) - place it in the Tracking tab
rule_fields.radius_cm: proximity RADIUS in cm around the landmark (a circle of this radius; diameter = 2x)
rule_fields.max_topups: max lick-triggered top-ups per visit (after the prime)
rule_fields.min_confidence: override the default min track confidence
rule_fields.lick_debounce_ms: ignore lick edges closer together than this (ms) - anti-chatter only; NOT a re-prime timer
rule_fields.topup_cooldown_ms: override the default within-visit top-up cooldown (ms)
rule_fields.rearm_refractory_ms: override the default between-visit anti-camp refractory (ms)
rule_fields.rearm_on_exit: re-arm (allow another prime) once the animal leaves the zone (still subject to rearm_refractory_ms)

templates.prime_and_lick_topup: On entering the zone (confident track within radius_cm of landmark): dispense once at 'port' (prime). Then each subsequent lick at 'port' while still inside dispenses again, up to 'max_topups' times, spaced by topup_cooldown_ms. To prime again the animal must LEAVE the zone AND wait out rearm_refractory_ms since the last fire; a re-entry inside the refractory pays nothing (no prime, so no top-ups).
